title: pyR0compute: A Python library for automated symbolic computation of the basic reproduction number via the next-generation matrix
description:
pyR0compute is a Python library for the automated symbolic computation of the basic reproduction number R0 of compartmental ODE models via the next-generation matrix method (van den Driessche and Watmough, 2002). The user writes the model and names the infected compartments; every other symbol is treated as a parameter.

  • Automatic classification of new-infection and transition terms, and solution of the disease-free equilibrium (DFE) block by block (strongly connected components), with a time limit per block and numerical fallback for blocks without closed form.
  • R0 in closed or compact form, numerical R0, step-by-step reports in LaTeX.
  • Verification of assumptions (A1)-(A5) of van den Driessche and Watmough, with a LaTeX report.
  • Local and global sensitivity analysis of R0 (LHS-PRCC and Sobol indices).
  • Numerical simulation of the model with fixed or random parameters and customisable plots.

Install with pip install pyR0compute. Example notebooks (Google Colab) are in the examples folder of the repository.
